excerpts.content:
As mentioned in <#745077610685661265>, we've renamed the EL and CL calls to ACDE & ACDC (⚡ !) respectively, and will be moving the streams/recording for protocol-related calls to the `@EthereumProtocol` YouTube channel 📺 

The ethereum/pm repo README has been updated to reflect the change: https://github.com/ethereum/pm#ethereum-project-management-repository

cc: <@&754066708418920553> as the folder structure has changed for future notes 😺
